# Aquila-7B Pretraining (Atlas 800T A2 · single-node 8 cards)

## 1. Environment

Atlas 800T A2 ×8 (add `--device=/dev/davinci1` through `--device=/dev/davinci7` for the actual number of cards) · Docker ≥ 24 · Python 3.12 · MindSpeed-LLM 26.2.0 · image `mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12` (must be imported into the local machine in advance)

## 2. Start Container

```bash
docker run -it -d \
      --ipc=host \
      --network=host \
      --pid=host \
      --name mindspeed_llm \
      --privileged \
      --shm-size=512g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
      --device=/dev/devmm_svm \
      --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
      -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
      -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
      -v /data:/data \
      -v /weights:/weights \
      mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
      /bin/bash
docker exec -it mindspeed_llm bash
```

## 3. Code and Dependencies

```bash
git clone -b 26.2.0 https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed-LLM.git
cd MindSpeed-LLM
git submodule update --init --recursive
git submodule update --init --remote 3rdparty/MindSpeed 3rdparty/FSDPTurbo
pip3 install -r requirements.txt
```

## 4. Weights

Download the weights from `https://huggingface.co/BAAI/Aquila-7B/tree/main` and convert them to Megatron format:

```bash
bash examples/legacy/aquila/ckpt_convert_aquila_hf2legacy.sh
```

## 5. Data

```bash
bash examples/legacy/aquila/data_convert_aquila_pretrain.sh
```

## 6. Launch

```bash
bash examples/legacy/aquila/pretrain_aquila_7b_ptd.sh
```

## 7. Verification

```bash
bash examples/legacy/aquila/evaluate_aquila_7b_ptd.sh
```

      -v /data:/data \
      -v /weights:/weights \
      mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \

Atlas 800T A2 ×2 nodes ×8 cards (add `--device=/dev/davinci1` through `--device=/dev/davinci7` according to the actual number of cards) · Docker ≥ 24 · Python 3.12 · MindSpeed-LLM 26.2.0 · Image `mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12` (must be imported into the local host in advance)

## 2. Start Container

```bash
docker run -it -d \
      --ipc=host \
      --network=host \
      --pid=host \
      --name mindspeed_llm \
      --privileged \
      --shm-size=512g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
      --device=/dev/devmm_svm \
      --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
      -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
      -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
      -v /data:/data \
      -v /weights:/weights \
      mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
      /bin/bash
docker exec -it mindspeed_llm bash
```

## 3. Code and Dependencies

```bash
git clone -b 26.2.0 https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed-LLM.git
cd MindSpeed-LLM
git submodule update --init --recursive
git submodule update --init --remote 3rdparty/MindSpeed 3rdparty/FSDPTurbo
pip3 install -r requirements.txt
```

## 4. Weights

Download the weights from `https://huggingface.co/Internlm/Internlm2-chat-20b/tree/main` and convert them to Megatron format:

```bash
bash examples/mcore/internlm2/ckpt_convert_internlm2_hf2mcore.sh
```

## 5. Data

```bash
bash examples/mcore/internlm2/data_convert_internlm2_instruction.sh
```

## 6. Launch

Run this on every node; fill in `NNODES`, `NODE_RANK`, and `MASTER_ADDR` according to the variables in the script.

```bash
bash examples/mcore/internlm2/pretrain_internlm2_20b_32k_16p_ptd.sh
```

## 7. Verification

```bash
bash examples/mcore/internlm2/evaluate_internlm2_20b_ptd.sh
```

Atlas 800T A2 ×2 nodes ×8 cards (add `--device=/dev/davinci1` through `--device=/dev/davinci7` for the actual number of cards) · Docker ≥ 24 · Python 3.12 · MindSpeed-LLM 26.2.0 · image `mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12` (must be imported into the local machine in advance)

## 2. Start Container

```bash
docker run -it -d \
      --ipc=host \
      --network=host \
      --pid=host \
      --name mindspeed_llm \
      --privileged \
      --shm-size=512g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
      --device=/dev/devmm_svm \
      --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
      -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
      -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
      -v /data:/data \
      -v /weights:/weights \
      mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
      /bin/bash
docker exec -it mindspeed_llm bash
```

## 3. Code and Dependencies

```bash
git clone -b 26.2.0 https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed-LLM.git
cd MindSpeed-LLM
git submodule update --init --recursive
git submodule update --init --remote 3rdparty/MindSpeed 3rdparty/FSDPTurbo
pip3 install -r requirements.txt
```

## 4. Weights

Download the weights from `https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-32B` and convert them to Megatron format:

```bash
bash examples/mcore/qwen3/ckpt_convert_qwen3_hf2mcore.sh
```

## 5. Data

```bash
bash examples/mcore/qwen3/data_convert_qwen3_instruction.sh
```

## 6. Launch

Run on each node; fill in `NNODES`, `NODE_RANK`, and `MASTER_ADDR` according to the variables in the script.

```bash
bash examples/mcore/qwen3/pretrain_qwen3_32b_4K_ptd.sh
```

## 7. Verification

```bash
bash examples/mcore/qwen3/evaluate_qwen3_32b_ptd.sh
```

Ascend 950DT&PR ×8 · Python 3.12 · CANN per the MindSpeed compatibility table · PyTorch 2.10.0 + TorchNPU 26.2.0 · MindSpeed-LLM 26.2.0

## 2. Install dependencies

```bash
pip install triton-ascend==3.6.0 --extra-index-url=https://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/ascend/repos/pypi

git clone https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed.git
cd MindSpeed
git checkout 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1
pip3 install -r requirements.txt
pip3 install -e .
cd ..

git clone -b 26.2.0 https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed-LLM.git
cd MindSpeed-LLM
git submodule update --init --recursive
git submodule update --init --remote 3rdparty/MindSpeed 3rdparty/FSDPTurbo
pip3 install -r requirements.txt
```

## 3. Weights

Download the weights (`https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2-1.5B/tree/main`) and convert them to Megatron format:

```bash
bash examples/mcore/qwen2/ckpt_convert_qwen2_hf2mcore.sh
```

## 4. Data

```bash
bash examples/mcore/qwen2/data_convert_qwen2_instruction.sh
```

## 5. Launch

```bash
bash examples/mcore/qwen2/pretrain_qwen2_1point5b_32k_ptd.sh
```

## 6. Verification

```bash
bash examples/mcore/qwen2/evaluate_qwen2_0point5b_ptd.sh
```

# Qwen2-7B Pretraining (Atlas 800T A2 · single-node 8 cards)

## 1. Environment

Atlas 800T A2 ×8 (add `--device=/dev/davinci1` through `--device=/dev/davinci7` for the actual number of cards) · Docker ≥ 24 · Python 3.12 · MindSpeed-LLM 26.2.0 · image `mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12` (must be imported into the local machine in advance)

## 2. Start Container

```bash
docker run -it -d \
      --ipc=host \
      --network=host \
      --pid=host \
      --name mindspeed_llm \
      --privileged \
      --shm-size=512g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
      --device=/dev/devmm_svm \
      --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
      -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
      -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
      -v /data:/data \
      -v /weights:/weights \
      mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
      /bin/bash
docker exec -it mindspeed_llm bash
```

## 3. Code and Dependencies

```bash
git clone -b 26.2.0 https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed-LLM.git
cd MindSpeed-LLM
git submodule update --init --recursive
git submodule update --init --remote 3rdparty/MindSpeed 3rdparty/FSDPTurbo
pip3 install -r requirements.txt
```

## 4. Weights

Download the weights from `https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2-7B/tree/main` and convert them to Megatron format:

```bash
bash examples/mcore/qwen2/ckpt_convert_qwen2_hf2mcore.sh
```

## 5. Data

```bash
bash examples/mcore/qwen2/data_convert_qwen2_instruction.sh
```

## 6. Launch

```bash
bash examples/mcore/qwen2/pretrain_qwen2_7b_32k_ptd.sh
```

## 7. Verification

```bash
bash examples/mcore/qwen2/evaluate_qwen2_7b_full_ptd.sh
```

Atlas 800T A3 ×8 · Python 3.12 · CANN installed per the MindSpeed compatibility table · PyTorch 2.10.0 + TorchNPU 26.2.0 · MindSpeed-LLM 26.2.0

## 2. Install Dependencies

```bash
pip install triton-ascend==3.6.0 --extra-index-url=https://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/ascend/repos/pypi

git clone https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed.git
cd MindSpeed
git checkout 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1
pip3 install -r requirements.txt
pip3 install -e .
cd ..

git clone -b 26.2.0 https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed-LLM.git
cd MindSpeed-LLM
git submodule update --init --recursive
git submodule update --init --remote 3rdparty/MindSpeed 3rdparty/FSDPTurbo
pip3 install -r requirements.txt
```

## 3. Weights

Download the weights (`https://huggingface.co/google/gemma-7b`) and convert them to Megatron format:

```bash
bash examples/mcore/gemma/ckpt_convert_gemma_hf2mcore.sh
```

## 4. Data

```bash
bash examples/mcore/gemma/data_convert_gemma_pretrain.sh
```

## 5. Launch

```bash
bash examples/mcore/gemma/pretrain_gemma_7b_ptd.sh
```

## 6. Verification

```bash
bash examples/mcore/gemma/evaluate_gemma_7b_ptd.sh
```

# Gemma2-9B Pretraining (Atlas 800T A2 · single-node 8 cards)

## 1. Environment

Atlas 800T A2 ×8 (add `--device=/dev/davinci1` through `--device=/dev/davinci7` for the actual number of cards) · Docker ≥ 24 · Python 3.12 · MindSpeed-LLM 26.2.0 · image `mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12` (must be imported into the local machine in advance)

## 2. Start Container

```bash
docker run -it -d \
      --ipc=host \
      --network=host \
      --pid=host \
      --name mindspeed_llm \
      --privileged \
      --shm-size=512g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
      --device=/dev/devmm_svm \
      --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
      -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
      -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
      -v /data:/data \
      -v /weights:/weights \
      mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
      /bin/bash
docker exec -it mindspeed_llm bash
```

## 3. Code and Dependencies

```bash
git clone -b 26.2.0 https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed-LLM.git
cd MindSpeed-LLM
git submodule update --init --recursive
git submodule update --init --remote 3rdparty/MindSpeed 3rdparty/FSDPTurbo
pip3 install -r requirements.txt
```

## 4. Weights

Download the weights from `https://huggingface.co/google/gemma-2-9b/tree/main` and convert them to Megatron format:

```bash
bash examples/mcore/gemma2/ckpt_convert_gemma2_hf2mcore.sh
```

## 5. Data

```bash
bash examples/mcore/gemma2/data_convert_gemma2_instruction.sh
```

## 6. Launch

```bash
bash examples/mcore/gemma2/pretrain_gemma2_9b_ptd.sh
```

## 7. Verification

```bash
bash examples/mcore/gemma2/evaluate_gemma2_9b_ptd.sh
```

# TeleChat3-36B training (Atlas 800T A2 · multi-node 2×8 cards)

## 1. Environment
Atlas 800T A2 ×16 (2 nodes × 8 cards), NPUS_PER_NODE=8, Docker ≥ 26.1.4, Python 3.12, MindFormers 2.0.0 / CANN 9.1.0 / MindSpore 2.10.0; the image tag is `swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-cann9.1.0-mindspore2.10.0-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12`.

## 2. Pull the image
Both machines pull the same image.
```bash
docker pull swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-cann9.1.0-mindspore2.10.0-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12
```

## 3. Start the container
Start one container on each node. Only card 0 is mounted by default, add `--device=/dev/davinci1:rwm` through `--device=/dev/davinci7:rwm` for the actual cards.
```bash
docker run -itd \
  --ipc=host \
  --network=host \
  --device=/dev/davinci0:rwm \
  --device=/dev/davinci_manager:rwm \
  --device=/dev/devmm_svm:rwm \
  --device=/dev/hisi_hdc:rwm \
  -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
  -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
  -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
  -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
  --name mf-telechat336b \
  swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-cann9.1.0-mindspore2.10.0-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
  /bin/bash
docker exec -it mf-telechat336b bash
```

## 4. Code and dependencies
The image already includes MindSpore Transformers, MindSpore and CANN; for the latest master code install from source in the container and it is ready once the self-check prints `All checks passed`:
```bash
git clone -b r2.0.0 https://atomgit.com/mindspore/mindformers.git
cd mindformers
python -c "import mindformers as mf;mf.run_check()"
```

## 5. Data
Pretraining dataset WikiText-103: convert `wiki.train.tokens` to jsonl first (one record per line, with `src`/`text`/`type`/`id`/`title`), then to Megatron binary; `--tokenizer-dir` points to the TeleChat3-36B tokenizer directory:
```shell
python toolkit/data_preprocess/megatron/preprocess_indexed_dataset.py \
  --input /path/to/data.jsonl \
  --output-prefix /path/to/wiki103-megatron \
  --tokenizer-type HuggingFaceTokenizer \
  --tokenizer-dir /path/to/TeleChat3-36B
```

## 6. Weights
Download the model weights, tokenizer and config from `TeleAI/TeleChat3-36B-Thinking` on ModelScope; pretraining from scratch needs no weights.

## 7. Launch
In `configs/telechat3/pretrain_telechat3_36b.yaml` set the parallelism to `data_parallel: 1`, `model_parallel: 8`, `pipeline_stage: 2`, `micro_batch_num: 4`, `use_seq_parallel: True`. Run on both machines, below is node 0; on node 1 change `node_rank` to 1 and set `master_ip` to the IP of Rank 0:
```shell
master_ip=192.168.1.1
node_rank=0
port=50001
bash scripts/msrun_launcher.sh "run_mindformer.py \
--config configs/telechat3/pretrain_telechat3_36b.yaml \
--auto_trans_ckpt False \
--use_parallel True \
--run_mode train" \
16 8 $master_ip $port $node_rank output/msrun_log False 7200
```

## 8. Verify
Logs are in `output/msrun_log/worker_0.log`; training is normal when `step` increases, `loss` decreases and `grad_norm` stays finite; with pipeline parallelism only the last stage shows the real loss, checkpoints are stored in `./output/checkpoint`.

```

--recompute_config.recompute True" \
$total_rank_num

# Qwen3-32B Training (Atlas 900 A3 SuperPoD · single node 8 cards)

## 1. Environment
Atlas 900 A3 SuperPoD ×8, NPUS_PER_NODE=8, Docker ≥ 26.1.4, Python 3.12, MindFormers 2.0.0 / CANN 9.1.0 / MindSpore 2.10.0, image tag `swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-cann9.1.0-mindspore2.10.0-a3-openeuler24.03-py3.12`.

## 2. Pull the image
```bash
docker pull swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-cann9.1.0-mindspore2.10.0-a3-openeuler24.03-py3.12
```

## 3. Start the container
Only card 0 is mounted by default, add `--device=/dev/davinci1:rwm` through `--device=/dev/davinci7:rwm` for the actual cards.
```bash
docker run -itd \
  --ipc=host \
  --network=host \
  --device=/dev/davinci0:rwm \
  --device=/dev/davinci_manager:rwm \
  --device=/dev/devmm_svm:rwm \
  --device=/dev/hisi_hdc:rwm \
  -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
  -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
  -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
  -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
  --name mf-qwen3 \
  swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-cann9.1.0-mindspore2.10.0-a3-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
  /bin/bash
docker exec -it mf-qwen3 bash
```

## 4. Code and dependencies
The image ships MindFormers 2.0.0; clone the master repo to get `configs/qwen3` and the launcher script, it is ready once `run_check` prints `All checks passed`:
```bash
git clone -b r2.0.0 https://atomgit.com/mindspore/mindformers.git
cd mindformers
python -c "import mindformers as mf;mf.run_check()"
```

## 5. Data
`configs/qwen3/finetune_qwen3.yaml` uses `HFDataLoader` to fetch `llm-wizard/alpaca-gpt4-data-zh` online automatically; when offline, set `path` to `"json"` and fill in `data_files`.

## 6. Weights
Download Qwen3-32B weights, Tokenizer and config from Hugging Face or ModelScope, and point `--pretrained_model_dir` at that directory when launching (e.g. `/path/to/Qwen3-32B`).

## 7. Launch
Single-node 8-card LoRA finetuning; first add `pet_config` under `model.model_config` in `configs/qwen3/finetune_qwen3.yaml` (`pet_type: lora`, `lora_rank: 8`, `lora_alpha: 16`, `target_modules` pointing at `word_embeddings`/`linear_qkv`/`linear_proj`/`linear_fc1`/`linear_fc2`); `total_rank_num=8` is the total card count, and `--parallel_config.model_parallel 8` matches it:
```bash
total_rank_num=8
bash scripts/msrun_launcher.sh "run_mindformer.py \
--config configs/qwen3/finetune_qwen3.yaml \
--auto_trans_ckpt True \
--use_parallel True \
--run_mode train \
--pretrained_model_dir /path/to/Qwen3-32B \
--parallel_config.data_parallel 1 \
--parallel_config.model_parallel 8 \
--parallel_config.pipeline_stage 1 \
--parallel_config.micro_batch_num 1 \
--recompute_config.recompute True" \
$total_rank_num
```

## 8. Verify
Logs are in `./output/msrun_log`, one per card, with `worker_7.log` for the last card; `step` increasing, `loss` decreasing and a finite `grad_norm` mean it is healthy, ckpt is saved in `./output/checkpoint`.

## 3. Start the container
Only card 0 is mounted by default, add `--device=/dev/davinci1:rwm` through `--device=/dev/davinci7:rwm` for the actual cards.
```bash
docker run -itd \
  --ipc=host \

  --device=/dev/davinci0:rwm \
  --device=/dev/davinci_manager:rwm \
  --device=/dev/devmm_svm:rwm \
  --device=/dev/hisi_hdc:rwm \
  -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
  -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
  -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
  -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
  --name mf-qwen \
  swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-cann9.1.0-mindspore2.10.0-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
  /bin/bash
docker exec -it mf-qwen bash
```
## 4. Code and dependencies
The image already bundles MindFormers 2.0.0; clone branch r2.0.0 for `research/qwen` and `scripts`, and `All checks passed` means the environment is ready.
```bash
git clone -b r2.0.0 https://atomgit.com/mindspore/mindformers.git
cd mindformers
python -c "import mindformers as mf;mf.run_check()"
```

```bash
python research/qwen/alpaca_converter.py \
 --data_path path/alpaca_data.json \
 --output_path /path/alpaca-data-conversation.json
python research/qwen/qwen_preprocess.py \
 --input_glob /path/alpaca-data-conversation.json \
 --model_file /path/qwen.tiktoken \
 --seq_length 8192 \
 --output_file /path/alpaca-8192.mindrecord
```
## 6. Weights
Download the converted Qwen-7B-Base weights (https://ascend-repo-modelzoo.obs.cn-east-2.myhuaweicloud.com/MindFormers/qwen/qwen_7b_base.ckpt) into `{path}/qwen_7b_base.ckpt`.
## 7. Launch
Replace `/path` with the real directory and `/path/to/ckpt` with the ckpt path from step 6, set the two environment variables, then launch.

cd research/qwen

 --config finetune_qwen_7b.yaml \
 --load_checkpoint /path/to/ckpt \
 --vocab_file /path/qwen.tiktoken \
 --train_dataset /path/alpaca-8192.mindrecord \
 --use_parallel True \
 --auto_trans_ckpt True \
 --run_mode finetune" 8
```
## 8. Verify
Logs are in `./output/log`; a rising `step`, a falling `loss` and a finite `grad_norm` mean training is healthy, and ckpts land in `./output/checkpoint`.

```bash
docker run -itd \
  --ipc=host \
  --network=host \
  --device=/dev/davinci0:rwm \

  -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
  -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
  -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
  -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
  --name mf-wizardcoder15b \
  swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-cann9.1.0-mindspore2.10.0-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
  /bin/bash

```

## 4. Code and dependencies
The image already includes the released MindFormers; clone the master repo to get `research/wizardcoder` and the launch script:
```bash
git clone -b r2.0.0 https://atomgit.com/mindspore/mindformers.git
cd mindformers
bash build.sh
```

## 5. Data
Download the SFT dataset CodeAlpaca-20k to `./finetune_dataset/code_alpaca_20k.json`; `--vocab_file`/`--merge_file` point to `vocab.json` and `merges.txt` downloaded with the weights under `./ckpt/`:
```bash
python research/wizardcoder/wizardcoder_preprocess.py \
--input_glob ./finetune_dataset/code_alpaca_20k.json \
--vocab_file ./ckpt/vocab.json \
--merge_file ./ckpt/merges.txt \
--output_file ./finetune_dataset/code_alpaca.mindrecord \
--seq_length 2048
```

## 6. Weights
Download the base weights `wizardcoder_15B.ckpt` from `https://ascend-repo-modelzoo.obs.cn-east-2.myhuaweicloud.com/MindFormers/wizardcode/wizardcoder_15B.ckpt` to `./ckpt/rank_0/`, it is ready for finetuning; to convert from HuggingFace weights use the script below, `--torch_path` is the bin file path:
```shell
python ./research/wizardcoder/convert_weight.py \
--torch_path ./ckpt/pytorch_model.bin \
--mindspore_path ./ckpt/rank_0/wizardcoder_15b.ckpt
```

## 7. Launch
Full-parameter finetuning; first edit `research/wizardcoder/run_wizardcoder.yaml`: set `load_checkpoint` to the weights directory, `dataset_dir` to the mindrecord, and keep `input_columns: ["input_ids", "labels"]`; the trailing `8` is the card count of the node:
```shell
bash scripts/msrun_launcher.sh \
"python research/wizardcoder/run_wizardcoder.py \
--config research/wizardcoder/run_wizardcoder.yaml \
--load_checkpoint ./output/transformed_checkpoint/ \
--use_parallel True \
--run_mode finetune \
--train_data ./finetune_dataset/code_alpaca.mindrecord" 8
```

## 8. Verify
Logs are in `output/msrun_log/worker_0.log`; training is normal when `step` increases, `loss` decreases and `grad_norm` stays finite, checkpoints are stored in `./output/checkpoint`.

# iFlytekSpark-13B Training (Atlas 800T A2 · 8-card single node · bare metal)

## 1. Environment

Atlas 800T A2 ×8 · Python 3.12 · MindSpore ≥ 2.10 · CANN and driver/firmware as required by the chosen MindSpore; install the NPU driver and firmware on the host first.

## 2. Install dependencies

Install MindFormers and HyperParallel (required for dynamic-graph training):

```bash
git clone -b master https://atomgit.com/mindspore/mindformers.git
cd mindformers
bash build.sh
```

```bash
cd ..  # currently in ~/mindformers, return to the home directory before cloning
git clone https://atomgit.com/mindspore/hyper-parallel.git
cd hyper-parallel
python setup.py bdist_wheel
pip install dist/hyper_parallel-*-py3-none-any.whl
```

Environment self-check, ready when it prints `All checks passed`:

```bash
python -c "import mindformers as mf;mf.run_check()"
```

## 3. Data

`{TOKENIZER_PATH}` is the directory containing `tokenizer.model`, `{RAW_DATA_PATH}` is the raw alpaca_gpt4 data, `{OUTPUT_FILE_PATH}` is the output mindrecord, and `SEQ_LENGTH` keeps the default 32768:

```bash
cd ..  # currently in ~/hyper-parallel, go up one level from the clone directory
cd mindformers
python ./research/iflytekspark/pretrain_data_preprocess.py \
--tokenizer /{TOKENIZER_PATH} \
--raw_data_path /{RAW_DATA_PATH} \
--output_filename /{OUTPUT_FILE_PATH} \
--seq_length SEQ_LENGTH
```

## 4. Weights

Download `iflytekspark_13b_base_bf16.ckpt` (https://ascend-repo-modelzoo.obs.cn-east-2.myhuaweicloud.com/MindFormers/iflytekspark/iflytekspark_13b_base_bf16.ckpt) and `tokenizer.model`, and store them as `model_dir/rank_0/xxx.ckpt`.

## 5. Launch

Replace `RANK_TABLE_FILE` with the json generated by `python ./mindformers/tools/hccl_tools.py --device_num "[0,8)"`, replace `model_dir` and `dataset_dir` with the weight directory and the mindrecord directory; the trailing 8 means 8 cards on one node:

```bash
cd research
bash run_singlenode.sh \
"python iflytekspark/run_iflytekspark.py \
--config iflytekspark/run_iflytekfpark_13b_pretrain_800T_A2_64G.yaml \
--load_checkpoint model_dir \
--use_parallel True \
--run_mode train \
--train_data dataset_dir" \
RANK_TABLE_FILE [0,8] 8
```

# LLaMA-7B training (Atlas 800T A2 · single node 8 cards)
## 1. Environment
Atlas 800T A2 ×8, NPUS_PER_NODE=8, Docker ≥ 26.1.4, Python 3.12, MindFormers 2.0.0 / CANN 9.1.0 / MindSpore 2.10.0
## 2. Pull the image
```bash
docker pull swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-cann9.1.0-mindspore2.10.0-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12
```
## 3. Start the container
Only card 0 is mounted by default, add `--device=/dev/davinci1:rwm` through `--device=/dev/davinci7:rwm` for the actual cards.
```bash
docker run -itd \
  --ipc=host \
  --network=host \
  --device=/dev/davinci0:rwm \
  --device=/dev/davinci_manager:rwm \
  --device=/dev/devmm_svm:rwm \
  --device=/dev/hisi_hdc:rwm \
  -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
  -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
  -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
  -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
  --name mf-llama \
  swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-cann9.1.0-mindspore2.10.0-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
  /bin/bash
docker exec -it mf-llama bash
```
## 4. Code and dependencies
The image already includes MindFormers 2.0.0; clone the r2.0.0 repo to get `configs/llama` and `scripts`, the environment is ready at `All checks passed`.
```bash
git clone -b r2.0.0 https://atomgit.com/mindspore/mindformers.git
cd mindformers
python -c "import mindformers as mf;mf.run_check()"
```
## 5. Data
Download alpaca (https://github.com/tatsu-lab/stanford_alpaca/blob/main/alpaca_data.json) and `tokenizer.model`, run both scripts in the `tools/dataset_preprocess/llama` directory, replace `{path}` with the real directory.
```bash
python alpaca_converter.py \
--data_path /{path}/alpaca_data.json \
--output_path /{path}/alpaca-data-conversation.json
python llama_preprocess.py \
--dataset_type qa \
--input_glob /{path}/alpaca-data-conversation.json \
--model_file /{path}/tokenizer.model \
--seq_length 2048 \
--output_file /{path}/alpaca-fastchat2048.mindrecord
```
## 6. Weights
Replace `TORCH_CKPT_DIR` with the HuggingFace weights directory and `MS_CKPT_NAME` with the output ckpt name; you can also download the converted open_llama_7b.ckpt (https://ascend-repo-modelzoo.obs.cn-east-2.myhuaweicloud.com/XFormer_for_mindspore/llama/open_llama_7b.ckpt).
```bash
python models/llama/convert_weight.py \
--torch_ckpt_dir TORCH_CKPT_DIR \
--mindspore_ckpt_path {path}/MS_CKPT_NAME
```
## 7. Launch
Replace `RANK_TABLE_FILE` with the json file name generated by `hccl_tools.py`; first point `dataset_dir`, `input_columns: ["input_ids", "labels"]` and `load_checkpoint` in `run_llama_7b.yaml` to the outputs of steps 5 and 6.
```bash
python tools/hccl_tools.py --device_num "[0,8)"
cd scripts
bash run_distribute.sh [RANK_TABLE_FILE] ../configs/llama/run_llama_7b.yaml [0,8] finetune
```
## 8. Verify
Logs are in `output/log`; training is normal when `step` increases, `loss` decreases and `grad_norm` stays finite, ckpts are written to `output/checkpoint`.

# LLaMA-7B Training (Atlas 800T A2 · 8-card single node · bare metal)

## 1. Environment

Atlas 800T A2 ×8 · Python 3.12 · MindSpore ≥ 2.10 · CANN and driver/firmware as required by the chosen MindSpore; install the NPU driver and firmware on the host first.

## 2. Install dependencies

Install MindFormers and HyperParallel (required for dynamic-graph training):

```bash
git clone -b master https://atomgit.com/mindspore/mindformers.git
cd mindformers
bash build.sh
```

```bash
cd ..  # currently in ~/mindformers, return to the home directory before cloning
git clone https://atomgit.com/mindspore/hyper-parallel.git
cd hyper-parallel
python setup.py bdist_wheel
pip install dist/hyper_parallel-*-py3-none-any.whl
```

Environment self-check, ready when it prints `All checks passed`:

```bash
python -c "import mindformers as mf;mf.run_check()"
```

## 3. Data

Download Wikitext2 from https://ascend-repo-modelzoo.obs.cn-east-2.myhuaweicloud.com/MindFormers/dataset/wikitext-2/wikitext-2-v1.zip, replace `{path}` with the directory holding `wiki.train.tokens` and `tokenizer.model`; the output is `{path}/wiki2048.mindrecord`:

```bash
cd ../mindformers/tools/dataset_preprocess/llama  # currently in ~/hyper-parallel, enter the llama preprocess directory
# Preprocess data and generate Mindrecord with tools/dataset_preprocess/llama/llama_preprocess.py
python llama_preprocess.py \
--dataset_type wiki \
--input_glob  /{path}/wiki.train.tokens \
--model_file /{path}/tokenizer.model \
--seq_length 2048 \
--output_file /{path}/wiki2048.mindrecord
```

## 4. Weights

Replace `TORCH_CKPT_DIR` with the HuggingFace weight directory of open_llama_7b, `{path}/MS_CKPT_NAME` with the output ckpt path:

```bash
cd ../../../..
python mindformers/models/llama/convert_weight.py \
--torch_ckpt_dir TORCH_CKPT_DIR \
--mindspore_ckpt_path {path}/MS_CKPT_NAME
```

## 5. Launch

Replace `hccl_xxxx.json` with the json generated by `python ./mindformers/tools/hccl_tools.py --device_num "[0,8)"`; `[0,8]` means 8 cards on one node:

```bash
export MS_ASCEND_CHECK_OVERFLOW_MODE="INFNAN_MODE"  # INFNAN mode recommended
cd mindformers/scripts
bash run_distribute.sh hccl_xxxx.json ../configs/llama/run_llama_7b.yaml [0,8] train
```

## 6. Verify

eval prints `PerplexityMetric`; PPL around 8.28 is normal.

```

A rising `step`, a falling `loss` and a finite `grad_norm` in the log mean training is healthy, and ckpts land in `output/checkpoint`.
